import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 300010;
    static int P;
    static long[][] f = new long[19][N];
    static long[] ifac = new long[N], fac = new long[N], inv = new long[N];
    static int n, k;
    static int[] lp = new int[N];

    static long fpow(long a, int b, long c) {
        long res = c;
        long base = a % P;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                res = res * base % P;
            }
            base = base * base % P;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init(int n) {
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P;
        }
        ifac[n] = fpow(fac[n], P - 2, 1);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            ifac[i] = ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % P;
        }
        inv[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            inv[i] = (long)(P - P / i) * inv[(int)(P % i)] % P;
        }
    }

    static void add(long[] x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < y; ++i) {
            x[i] += y;
            if (x[i] >= P) x[i] -= P;
        }
    }

    static void sub(long[] x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < y; ++i) {
            x[i] -= y;
            if (x[i] < 0) x[i] += P;
        }
    }

    static void FMT(long[] f, int n) {
        for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += l << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; ++j) {
                    add(f, i + j + l);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void IFMT(long[] f, int n) {
        for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += l << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; ++j) {
                    sub(f, i + j + l);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ln(long[] f, long[] g, int n) {
        g[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            g[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                g[i] = (g[i] + f[i - j] * g[j] % P * j) % P;
            }
            g[i] = (f[i] + g[i] * (P - inv[i]) % P) % P;
        }
    }

    static void exp(long[] f, long[] g, int n) {
        g[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            g[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                g[i] = (g[i] + g[i - j] * f[j] % P * j) % P;
            }
            g[i] = g[i] * inv[i] % P;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        P = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        long ans = fpow(k, n, 1);
        if ((n & 1) == 0) {
            int m = (int) (Math.log(n) / Math.log(2)) + 1;
            init(1 << m);
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << m); ++i) {
                f[pop(i)][i] = ifac[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
                FMT(f[i], 1 << m);
            }
            long[] F = new long[20], G = new long[20];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << m); ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    F[j] = f[j][i];
                }
                ln(F, G, m + 1);
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    G[j] = G[j] * k % P;
                }
                exp(G, F, m + 1);
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                    f[j][i] = F[j];
                }
            }
            IFMT(f[pop(n)], 1 << m);
            ans = (P + ans - f[pop(n)][n] * fac[n] % P) % P;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static int pop(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }
}
